@brain.label: MEASURED

ppm_cmd_handler.basis: the cmd_ptr table (filled by ppm_init_cmd_ptr) holds only cmd_* handlers

buddy_call_brain.basis: jalr a0 / jalr s0 = the brain's H2 and H1 entries

memset.basis: newlib memset: computed jump/call into its own store table, no frame

neorv32_uart_printf.basis: switch table on the format character

sp_restore.buddy_abort_land: lw sp from buddy_jmp_sp: unwinds to buddy_call_brain's own frame (abort path, reached only through mepc)

026.what: the code as it is (final 0.2.6): a polled thread; MEI and MTI are enabled only while a brain call runs (zz_buddy.c run_call) and go through buddy_trap

levels.name: thread
levels.basis: reset entry: crt0 -> main -> ppm_start (main loop, dispatch, buddy_event)

levels.name: mti
levels.basis: MTIME tick (cause 7) inside a brain call

levels.name: mei
levels.basis: mailbox latch (cause 11) inside a brain call or a tick's MIE window

030.what: the 0.3.0 design: L1 mailbox MEI > L2a timer MTI > L2b MSI > L3 thread (job queue); every level runs with interrupts open above it (software nesting, 80 B frame per level); F5/F4 buffers static in WRAM

proxy.basis: L3 = the job queue: today's main loop with the job commands (DA/DB/F2/F4/C6/saves), measured here, the brain call removed (it moves to MSI), and the chip's own job chains (PROXY)
L2b = the brain call (today's buddy_call_brain + @brain, under the glue frame of buddy_event) or one song-tick slice or the Z80 packet + Boom Box feed
L2a = timer wheel (an estimated 32 B frame) + the urgent tick promotion (rest of the tick + packet) or the watchdog

L1 = mailbox decode + gates + reply: today's dispatcher with the job commands removed (they become L3 jobs), measured, or the chip's dispatcher chain (PROXY); + an estimated 64 B for the status layer and the held-post entry
